title: RelayProxyConfig
description: A Relay Proxy automatic configuration entry.

_id.description: The unique identifier of this configuration.

name.description: The human-readable name of this configuration.

fullKey.description: The full key for authenticating Relay Proxy instances. Only returned at creation time.

displayKey.description: The last four characters of the full key.

creationDate.description: Unix epoch timestamp when the configuration was created.

lastModified.description: Unix epoch timestamp of the last modification.

policy.description: Policy statements controlling which projects and environments this Relay Proxy can access.
